description: Include the web identity token in the credential cache key to prevent collisions across different tokens for the same role.

Removes the ``AAA Certificate Services`` root from the vendored CA bundle in response to the eMudhra/emSign CA incident. Sectigo used this root to cross-sign eMudhra intermediate CAs whose private keys were compromised. See `#10790 <https://github.com/aws/aws-cli/pull/10790>`__.
